issue_contract.target: The existing local-calendar-day ignition label. Inputs must be known before the local day begins.

sources.role: label and retrospective past-only ignition history
sources.observation_coverage: Ontario records with dates in the committed panel, 2010-05-01 through 2019-10-31
sources.historical_semantics: retrospective recorded incident dates; the build only counts records whose ignition_date is strictly earlier than the issue date
sources.quality_notes: NFDB point positions and dates have variable precision. The source does not establish historical report/discovery availability.

sources.role: historical noon weather and Canadian Fire Weather Index components
sources.observation_coverage: 2010-01-01 through 2019-12-31; the build checks the required day-before-issue coverage
sources.historical_semantics: retrospective hindcast. The feature uses a record dated t-1 for issue date t and records the observation date, station count, distance, interpolation and calculation-status flags.
sources.quality_notes: The public archive readme describes its historical system transition, but does not provide per-record historical publication timestamps. Do not replay this archive as an operational alert feed.

sources.historical_semantics: static ground-elevation terrain only; it is not used as a vegetation, disturbance, road, or built-environment proxy
sources.quality_notes: CDEM is a legacy terrain model. The summary uses nine equal-area samples in each existing EPSG:3978 grid cell and retains coverage.

sources.historical_semantics: not materialized in v1. ERA5-Land is a retrospective reanalysis and must be labelled as hindcast if added.
sources.quality_notes: An archived forecast product issued before the target day is required for an operational next-day claim.

sources.historical_semantics: deferred. A current reprocessed annual image is not accepted for an earlier issue date without a retained, previously released vintage and a known available-at date.
sources.quality_notes: No time-safe local historical asset and publication ledger were supplied; v1 intentionally does not fill these fields with a 2024/current map.

sources.historical_semantics: deferred. A licensed historic geometry extract and redistribution clearance are required before length/distance values can be materialized.
sources.quality_notes: The current Ontario Road Network is explicitly not substituted because it may encode post-2019 access.

sources.historical_semantics: deferred pending an archived geography/value extract and an available-at ledger for each Census vintage.
sources.quality_notes: No current population or settlement geometry is silently backfilled into 2010-2019.

prohibited_predictors: final fire perimeter or final fire size
future fire perimeter, future active-fire detection, or post-event burn product
post-issue weather observation or same-day completed FWI
current road, fuel, land-cover, or settlement geometry without a valid historical vintage
